Name: Treasure Hoarder Weapons
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This is a content pack for Advanced Melee Framework and JSON Assets that adds the following weapons:

[b][size=4]Purse Cutter Blade[/size][/b]

A razor sharp knife that is easily concealed despite its golden glow. Has a chance to give its wielder a percent of damage dealt in the form of coins.

[b][size=4]Midas Sword[/size][/b]

A brilliantly glowing golden blade that seems to whisper promises of untold wealth. Has a chance to give its wielder a percent of a slain monster's health in the form of coins.

[b][size=4]Golden Goose[/size][/b]

A long-necked pole with a glowing, golden head infused with the luck of a thousand leprechauns. Has chances to give its wielder both double drops and bonus copper, iron, and gold ores on slaying a monster.


On running the game with this mod installed, a [b]config.json[/b] file will be created in the [b][AMF] Treasure Hoarder Weapons [/b]folder. You can use that file to customize some of this mod's variables.


[size=5][b]Technical Notes[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JSON Assets[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7886]Advanced Melee Framework[/url].
